$comment: #7675 IfcComplexProperty walk budget: ONE vector for all three walks, the server data model (apps/server/src/services/data_model/tests.rs), the Rust STEP exporter's property base (rust/export/src/step_log/base_tests.rs) and the browser's resolveComplexPropertyValue (packages/parser/test/complex-property-budget.test.ts). Bounds and markers live in ifc_lite_core::limits. 'Wide' lists one member 1100 times (visit budget), 'Fan' lists itself 3 times (k^8 under the depth cap alone), 'LongFan' does the same with a 10 KB usage name, and Pset_Refs lists 'LongFan' 100 times (byte budget, shared by the extraction). A value too long to inline is pinned by length and SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes; a repeated property by its values joined with a newline. maxTotalBytes bounds every property value of the wall together.
